svg.title: What every pin connects to
svg.text: No CPU and no memory: a PC drives the timing hardware over the demo board's USB serial port.
TX: replies and events to the PC
Host PC, via the demo board
the RP2350 is the clock, reset and USB-serial bridge
eight capture channels; every edge is timestamped
three trigger outputs, each pulsing at an exact tick
EVTP one-clock pulse per captured event
live view of the event queue without the serial link
Signal flow: the dashes move toward the chip on inputs and away from it on outputs. Colours: purple clock/reset, blue inputs, green outputs, orange bidirectional.
